split.method: stratified 80:20 on compounds, strata = log Kp quartile x analgesic status

compound_level_cv.method: RepeatedKFold, units = compounds of the training set
compound_level_cv.used_for: the cross-validated R2 and RMSE reported in Table 2
compound_level_cv.note: reproducible from the seed; no per-fold file is emitted for this scheme

grouped_cv.guarantee: all records of a compound share a fold; verified by assertion

ionization_analysis.note: run in a separate environment installed for this analysis; the RDKit build differs from the one used for the descriptors above
